detail.longDescription: Embeddable Live Chat Widget (Intercom Alternative) Say hello to the ETHOS Live Chat Widget! 💬 You can now embed a 100% serverless, E2EE live chat on any website — like Intercom or Crisp, but with zero central backend, databases, or monthly fees! 🔹 Single <script> tag setup 🔹 Isolated via Shadow DOM 🔹 Captures visitor page context 🔹 Direct E2EE to your ETHOS app Source & guide: github.com/aitherapp/ethos-core # WebDev # Privacy # Intercom # E2EE # OpenSource
